text:
We're Hiring: Full Stack Development Engineer (FDE) Intern – AI, RAG & Predictive Analytics.

Are you passionate about Artificial Intelligence, Full Stack Development, and building products that solve real-world problems?

We're looking for Full Stack Development Engineer (FDE) Interns to join us in building the next generation of AI-powered products at CheriMind and CheriMathLab.

About CM & CML

CheriMind is a Private Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) AI Platform that enables organizations to build secure AI assistants using their own knowledge. Unlike public AI systems, CheriMind provides source-grounded answers from trusted documents, databases, websites, and enterprise knowledge while keeping data private and secure.

CheriMathLab is an AI-powered learning platform that helps students, teachers, schools, and parents through personalized learning, assessments, analytics, and intelligent AI assistants.
 
What You'll Work On
You'll build real production features across:
Private RAG & Enterprise AI 
AI Agents & Workflow Automation 
Intelligent Document Processing 
Enterprise Search 
Student, Teacher & School Analytics 
Predictive AI Models 
AI Cost Optimization 
AI Evaluation & Observability 
Full Stack Web Applications 
This isn't a chatbot internship—you'll work on production AI systems used by real users.
 
Technologies You'll Use
AI & ML: RAG, AI Agents, LangChain, LangGraph, Ollama, DeepSeek, Llama, Qwen, Embeddings, Vector Databases
Backend: ASP.NET Core, Python, REST APIs
Frontend: React, Next.js, TypeScript
Database: PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis
DevOps: Linux, Docker, Git, GitHub
 
Who Should Apply?
We're looking for students or recent graduates in:
Computer Science 
Artificial Intelligence 
Machine Learning 
Data Science 
Software Engineering 
Information Technology 
If you're curious, enjoy solving challenging engineering problems, and love building AI products, we'd love to hear from you.
 
What You'll Gain
Hands-on experience building production AI systems 
Enterprise RAG architecture 
AI Agent development 
Predictive Analytics 
Full Stack Development 
Mentorship from experienced engineers 
Internship Certificate 
Potential PPO based on performance 
 
Internship Details
    Location: Remote
   Duration: 3–6 Months
   Type: Full-time / Part-time
    Stipend: Based on skills and performance
 
How to Apply
Please email the following to connect@cherimathlab.com:
Resume 
GitHub Profile 
LinkedIn Profile 
Project or Portfolio Links 
Availability 
Subject: Application – FDE Intern (AI, RAG & Full Stack)
 
If you're excited about building AI that solves real problems not just demos we'd love to hear from you.
